parts.text: Here is the whole journey in one picture. {email}It starts when a customer places an order. {ai}The system reads it and lays out the lines, {approve}a reviewer approves it, {qb}and the receipt goes to accounting. {po}When the customer sends an amendment, {compare}every line is checked against the original, and one quantity is flagged. {vus}The order goes to the warehouse, {ups}the courier ships it, {paid}the customer pays, {closed}and the order is closed.

Behind every task is the inbox engine. {inbox}Every few minutes it reads the orders and help inboxes, {sort}sorts each email into a new order, an amendment, a return or a question, {junk}and sets the rest aside. {scan}Then the AI reads the email that matters {fields}and pulls out the customer, the lines and the total, {task}and a task lands in the queue with a confidence score. {review}A person makes the call, {order}the approved task moves the order forward, {sync}and the order trades data with accounting, the courier and the warehouse.
